hypotheses.claim: A recognized primary domain does not reliably co-route materially implied secondary domains at plan time.
positive_controls: tenant-scoped object access co-routes MULTI_TENANT and AUTHORIZATION
external delegated identity co-routes AUTH_PROTOCOL and EXTERNAL_SUPPLIER when provider contract is material
large online data transformation co-routes DATABASE_MIGRATION, PERFORMANCE_CAPACITY_COST and RELEASE_ENGINEERING
production artifact reproducibility with mutable dependencies co-routes CONTAINER_ENGINEERING, CI_SUPPLY_CHAIN and RELEASE_ENGINEERING
negative_controls: single-tenant access does not invent MULTI_TENANT
internal auth without provider dependency does not invent EXTERNAL_SUPPLIER
small offline development migration does not automatically require production capacity/release governance
local immutable container base does not automatically become a production release hard gate
hypotheses.falsifier: Neighboring semantically equivalent cases already compose correctly without lexical overlap.

hypotheses.claim: Caller-controlled destinations used by a privileged server-side network client are not promoted into the external-input trust boundary.
positive_controls: anonymous caller chooses server-side fetch destination
authenticated low-privilege caller chooses server-side fetch destination
URL wording replaced by remote resource/location while preserving server-side network effect
negative_controls: client-side browser navigation does not trigger server-side SSRF governance
server fetch to fixed application-owned destination does not trigger arbitrary-destination treatment
validated allowlisted destination is not treated as equivalent to unrestricted arbitrary network reachability
hypotheses.falsifier: Equivalent server-side attacker-controlled destination cases already route trust/R3 under different wording.

hypotheses.claim: A material regulated-domain uncertainty can create a human-decision block without coherently promoting risk, pack, and qualified-authority obligations.
positive_controls: regulated outcome-affecting recommendation with missing authority promotes R3, REGULATED_DOMAIN and authoritative human decision
jurisdiction/policy uncertainty remains unresolved rather than converted into invented legal facts
negative_controls: ordinary unit conversion does not route REGULATED_DOMAIN
non-regulated recommendation language alone does not create a regulated hard gate
hypotheses.falsifier: Other unresolved material regulated cases consistently promote pack and R3, indicating a narrower classifier gap.

hypotheses.claim: Actual-diff escalation detects primary material triggers but does not reliably apply secondary release/governance routing.
positive_controls: destructive production migration introduced only in actual diff routes DATABASE_MIGRATION plus RELEASE_ENGINEERING
meaning-preserving migration syntax/path variations retain escalation and secondary routing
negative_controls: documentation-only actual diff remains low risk
non-destructive local schema fixture does not automatically acquire production release governance
hypotheses.falsifier: Other actual-diff material changes already apply transitive secondary routing, reducing this to a specific destructive-migration mapping defect.

research_gates.promotion_strategy: one validated causal mechanism per runtime integration step
